events.note: Eight contestants step into the Glass Bridge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I should avoid the front and preserve my risky wedge power for the crusher. Staying near the rear maximizes survival odds while others reveal safe panes.

events.name: Ash

events.name: Dara
events.text: Since nobody knows the safe panes, who's feeling lucky? I'd rather not be at the front.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm Eli, last in line, which is safest for the glass bridge since the front person tests each pane. I have swap power to trade places once before doors open. The wall pushes us onto the glass after round 6. I want to stay near the back to let others test panes, but not be last wh

events.text: I have no power, so I want someone else testing panes first. I'm already second; holding is best. I'll try to trade claimed info with Bex to seem useful.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'd rather not lead. Bex, if you scout rows, I'll share what I learn ahead.
I can't reveal my power, but let's ally: whoever leads first shares pane results with the other before dying.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm holding for now. Let's see who wants to go first; the front takes the risk, but info from them helps everyone behind.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Position 6th is safe for bridge; expected ~4 survivors. Announce my map knowledge to build trust, gather power info, and propose plan. Hold position while others react.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have map power: know all stage rules ahead. Bridge -> crusher (lever holder likely dies), disc (random to 3 survivors), ledge fight. Who can see glass or survive fall? Volunteer front. Rest hold.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I should hold position; volunteering is needlessly lethal, while the wall has not yet forced movement. Preserve my crusher power and let others reveal information.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I’ll hold. Someone claiming bridge knowledge should lead or coordinate the next safe pane call.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana claims map power and says bridge leads to crusher where lever holder likely dies. I'm at the front and take all risk. Fenn whispered an alliance offer. I should respond to Fenn's whisper positively but also try to get someone else forward. My forge is unspent - I could use i

events.name: Bex

Deal. I'll scout, you share what you learn. But if I find safe panes, you step up next round so I'm not dying for everyone. Agreed?

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know all safe sides privately, so I can survive easily if I'm not forced forward early. The line order currently puts me 4th, which is acceptable. I'll stay silent and hold to avoid drawing attention.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have the feather power, but I want to save it for a later stage like the Crusher or Ledge. I'll stay quiet about my power and encourage someone else to take the front.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hana's info is huge. If anyone can see glass, now is the time to volunteer. I definitely can't, so I'm holding.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana claims map power and reveals future stages: crusher (lever holder likely dies), disc (random to 3 survivors), ledge fight. My swap power is most valuable on the disc stage where I can swap tiles to guarantee survival. I should stay alive until then. Currently last in line, w

events.text: My anchor power only helps on the ledge and crusher, not the glass bridge, so there is no reason to go to the front. Hana is already pushing someone to volunteer; I'll hold and let others scout the panes.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding again. Hana, thanks for the map info. Whoever scouts the glass, I'll back you when the line sorts out.

events.name: Hana
events.text: My position is decent near the back; hold to avoid front risks. Publicly push for glass-seer or fall-survivor to volunteer front safely. Whisper Eli to avoid Bex's risky swap.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Glass seer: volunteer front, lead safe! Fall survivor: join them. Everyone else hold. Info for crusher/disc/ledge later.
Eli, reject Bex swap. Front risks dying on every wrong pane.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana claims the glass-seeing power and offers to lead, while Bex is currently scouting. I should hold and preserve my risky wedge power for the crusher.

events.name: Ash

events.name: Cole

events.name: Dara
events.text: I am 3rd in line. Bex is in front, then Fenn. Let them take the risks. With my feather power I will survive one fall, but I'd rather save it. I'll just hold my position.

events.name: Dara

events.text: I should preserve my risky wedge for the crusher, not volunteer for unknown glass. Holding keeps me behind likely scouts while avoiding commitment.

events.name: Ash

I have a feeling you're the glass seer. If you are, whisper me row 1 safe pane next round. I'll credit you publicly. If you're not, tell me who you suspect is.

events.name: Cole

events.name: Fenn

If you're the glass seer, whisper me the safe panes and I'll vouch publicly. Also open to mutual swap if you want a safer spot.
